response.overview: This is a parable about the future of AI . In 2035, the history of AI development is gradually erased from the mainstream of the world. Two girls who love each other are in conflict over a 'Flamingo' AI, which is supposed to disappear and intervene in the lives of five women. What time is the past? What time is the present? When is the future? What is right and wrong? In the future, what kind of life will human beings live after the use of AI is banned, and whether the women are looking for the Flamingo or the traces of the development of AI.
response.title: 2035 Global Ban on AI
